DECISION 2026-09-21 (operating agent, route=agent): VOLUME IS NOT THE LEVER, and this item is no longer waiting on Tim. Evidence: publishing ran 1-8/day Aug 30 - Sep 9 and produced +6 followers in 30 days while cadence already sits at the configured 3/day cap; and the strategy layer was blind for ~4 months because insights collection was dead until 2026-09-20. Decisions: (1) cadence STAYS at the cap -- raising it adds burst/spam risk with no measured return; (2) the next levers are the now-live insights loop plus image-grounded captions (see vision-caption-path-never-taken and persona-age-read-youthful), which is the signal the strategy layer needed all along; (3) treat 1000-by-2027-08-20 as a direction, not a forecast -- the honest metric is the trajectory ratio, not a catch-up plan built on posting volume. The review-brain cooldown to 2026-09-23 stands; the next review judges the caption/insight levers, not cadence.
